verified.label: Integrity verified
verified.detail: The checked published files match the downloaded Manifest. This browser does not independently verify Bitcoin or source correctness.

pending.label: Timestamping
pending.detail: Signed and submitted; the Bitcoin timestamp takes a few hours to confirm. This is normal, not an error.

mismatch.label: Integrity mismatch
mismatch.detail: These files do not match the anchored fingerprint. The deployment may be incomplete or the data altered — do not cite this version.

unverified.label: Not verified
unverified.detail: The verification record could not be reached, so nothing is being claimed either way.

invalid.label: Verification metadata invalid
invalid.detail: The Manifest or witness metadata is malformed, so no integrity claim is made.

verify.title: Verify this data
verify.lede: Every published dataset is fingerprinted in a versioned Manifest. This page checks published bytes; it does not establish that source numbers are correct or independently verify a blockchain witness.
verify.currentHint: Your browser recomputed these fingerprints locally just now.
verify.filesHint: Each fingerprint is the SHA-256 of the file's own bytes. Recompute it and you should get the same string.
verify.noManifest: No integrity manifest is being served, so there is nothing to verify against yet.
verify.witnessHint: These self-hosted records help discover OpenTimestamps and Sigstore evidence; this page does not independently validate either network.
verify.provesBody: The downloaded files match the downloaded Manifest within this browser check. Independently verify OpenTimestamps and Sigstore using the tools below.
verify.notProvesBody: It does not mean the numbers are correct. If a source was wrong, we have preserved that error faithfully. Data quality is carried by the confidence and source labels on each indicator, not by this page.
verify.yourselfHint: Nothing here needs software written by us.
verify.historyHint: Versioned witness records retained by this publication log. Check the linked proof with independent tools.
verify.noDirectWitnessFee: $0 direct witness fee; hosting, Actions and node operations still have costs.
verify.terminalHint: Run these anywhere. Neither tool is ours.

about.heroLede: Borneo Tracker brings environmental, social and sustainability indicators together in one clear and accessible platform.
about.positioning: Measure Borneo. Understand Borneo. Strengthen Borneo.
about.purposeBody: We support public awareness, regional monitoring and evidence-informed decisions by making Borneo's sustainability data easier to explore, compare and understand.
about.howItWorksIntro: Borneo Tracker follows a simple path from public evidence to readable intelligence, so users can see what is measured, where it came from and what it means for resilience.
about.howItWorksMonitorBody: The platform brings together sustainability indicators across Borneo's territories, including environment, social conditions and SDG progress.
about.howItWorksVerifyBody: Each indicator is paired with source, update and confidence information so users can judge the evidence behind the dashboard.
about.howItWorksScoreBody: Scored indicators feed the 0-100 Resilience Score and six True Wealth essentials, making weak points visible without filling gaps with invented data.
about.resilienceExplainerPart1: here simply means how well a place can look after its own people across life's essentials — from food and energy to housing, healthcare, education and everyday wellbeing — even when times get hard. A territory can look wealthy on paper yet still be fragile if just one of these essentials is weak. Borneo Tracker turns the data into a single 0–100
about.resilienceExplainerPart2: that measures exactly this, rather than judging a place by income alone.
about.resilienceStatusBody: A single 0–100 score with a traffic-light status — green (resilient), amber (at risk) or red (critical) — so a territory's overall standing reads at a glance.
about.resilienceByPillarBody: The score broken into its six essentials — Food, Energy, Education, Shelter, Healthcare and Entertainment — shown as a hexagon and a weakest-first list, so you can see which one is holding a territory back.
about.transparentDataBody: Every indicator includes its source and update information so users can understand where the data comes from and how it supports the dashboard.
about.noticeBody: Borneo Tracker supports awareness and monitoring. For emergencies, always contact the relevant official emergency services.
about.monitorEnvironmentBody: Forest cover, deforestation, air quality, water quality and fire hotspots.
about.monitorSocialBody: Poverty, employment, education, healthcare and clean water access.
about.monitorSustainabilityBody: Regional performance across priority Sustainable Development Goals.
about.exploreEsgBody: Review environmental, social and governance performance.
about.exploreSdgBody: Follow progress toward priority Sustainable Development Goals.
about.exploreNewsBody: Read AI-curated sustainability news with credited sources.
about.exploreCommunityBody: Discuss wildlife, culture, livelihoods and everyday life with people across Borneo.
about.scopeEsgSdgBody: Environmental, social, governance and SDG data
about.scopeSourcesBody: Clear data sources and regular updates
